sloka: समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकं महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम् ।सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम् ।। ५.३७.६४।।।।
transliteration: samīkṣya taṁ saṁyati citrakārmukaṁ mahābalaṁ vāsavatulyavikramam ।salakṣmaṇaṁ ko viṣaheta rāghavaṁ hutāśanaṁ dīptamivānileritam ।। 5.37.64।।।।

translations.english: "I have seen and heard about Rama's conquest of enemies and his valiant deeds in war. Indeed, gods gandharvas, nagas or even demons cannot match him in war.
